notes: All 15 source and 23 target IDs partitioned exactly once.

The copula *was* goes to the interrogative `מָה`, which is the predicate of the verbless clause, exactly as rule 20 gives *is* to the `מִי` of *What man is this*; the MACULA gloss attaching *[was]* to the suffix is a display defect and not evidence (rule 39).

`בְּ` + `תּוֹךְ` is split here because the ASV spends separate English words (*in the midst of*) on the pair, so rule 30's one-English-word condition is unmet; the same pair fuses at v.6 where the ASV writes only *among*.
`כְּפִיר` → *young lions* heads on *lions*, the word naming the creature, with *young* a specifier, on the `תַּנִּין` → *sea monsters* pattern of rule 31.
